description: Routes a collaborator's four MIDI ports to and from MIDI hardware on this machine, attached to a CV Peer
notes: it goes immediately to the right of a CV Peer and reads No CV Peer until it has one; the Hub can be set to add one beside every CV Peer it creates
the panel has no jacks; the four ports on each side are pointed at devices from the module's menu, and a port with no device does nothing
the module is not offered in the module browser in this release, and a patch saved with one in it goes on loading and running
menu: MIDI Device Assignment — a heading over the four ports
Input Device — under each port; chooses which MIDI device on this machine feeds that port to the collaborator, or (None)
Output Device — under each port; chooses which MIDI device on this machine that port plays, or (None)
